title: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. finally hits first Rogers Centre home run
content:
It took nearly all season, but Vladimir Guerrero Jr. finally has hit a home run at his home ballpark of Rogers Centre. The home run, which came in the Blue Jays’ 75th home game and with just two weeks remaining in the campaign, was met with a raucous ovation from the Toronto faithful.

So much so that Guerrero even received a curtain call.

For the still-in-the-hunt Blue Jays, the home run could not have come at a better time. Guerrero’s blast was part of a back-to-back-to-back barrage of homers against Baltimore Orioles starter Trevor Rogers, which began with a blow from George Springer and was capped with a solo shot from rookie Kazuma Okamoto, his 32nd of the season.

The home run was Guerrero’s ninth of the season. He hit 23 last season, including 12 at home.

This story will be updated.
